Called by every OVM write and deposit. |

Reports PUBLIC_FORWARDER_HOLDS_ROLE in `findings`. |

Checks provenance, the WITHDRAWAL role, the fee and, with a status source, every beacon chain rule that would make the chain ignore the request and keep the fee (VALIDATOR_NOT_ACTIVE, CREDENTIALS_NOT_SOURCE, VALIDATOR_EXITING, VALIDATOR_TOO_NEW, ...). Rules it could not check: VALIDATOR_STATUS_UNCHECKED (warning). |
| <code>prepareConsolidate</code> | <span class="sdk-type">( input: <a href="#PrepareConsolidateInput">PrepareConsolidateInput</a>, ) =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="./send#Prepared">Prepared</a>&lt;'consolidate'&gt;&gt;</span> | EIP-7251 consolidation requests through the OVM. A source equal to its target switches that validator to 0x02 (compounding). A target with another withdrawal address is allowed by the chain but moves the stake out of this OVM: CONSOLIDATION_CREDENTIALS_DIFFER (warning), which `send` asks to be acknowledged. |
| <code>prepareDistribute</code> | <span class="sdk-type">( input: <a href="#PrepareDistributeInput">PrepareDistributeInput</a>, ) =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="./send#Prepared">Prepared</a>&lt;'distribute'&gt;&gt;</span> | Distributes the OVM's balance to its principal and reward recipients (`distributeFunds`, or `distributeFundsPull` with `mode: 'pull'`). Anyone may send it. Nothing to pay: NOTHING_TO_DISTRIBUTE. To also distribute the splits behind the recipients use [`splits.prepareDistributeAll`](../splits.md#prepareDistributeAll). |
| <code>previewDistribute</code> | <span class="sdk-type">( input: <a href="#PrepareDistributeInput">PrepareDistributeInput</a>, ) =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="./send#PreviewResult">PreviewResult</a>&lt;<a href="#DistributePreview">DistributePreview</a>&gt;&gt;</span> | The reads and routing of `prepareDistribute` without a transaction; zeros instead of NOTHING_TO_DISTRIBUTE, so a page can show the figures with the button disabled. |
| <code>prepareGrantRoles</code> | <span class="sdk-type">(input: <a href="#GrantRolesInput">GrantRolesInput</a>) =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="./send#Prepared">Prepared</a>&lt;'role'&gt;&gt;</span> | Grants `roles` to `user` (`grantRoles`); owner only. Reports ROLE_GRANT_CONSOLIDATION and ROLE_GRANT_DEPOSIT_TO_PRINCIPAL (warnings) for the grants that can move the stake. |
| <code>prepareRevokeRoles</code> | <span class="sdk-type">(input: <a href="#RevokeRolesInput">RevokeRolesInput</a>) =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="./send#Prepared">Prepared</a>&lt;'role'&gt;&gt;</span> | Revokes `roles` from `user` (`revokeRoles`); owner only. |
| <code>prepareRenounceRoles</code> | <span class="sdk-type">( input: <a href="#RenounceRolesInput">RenounceRolesInput</a>, ) =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="./send#Prepared">Prepared</a>&lt;'role'&gt;&gt;</span> | Gives up the sender's own `roles` (`renounceRoles`). |
| <code>prepareRequestOwnershipHandover</code> | <span class="sdk-type">( input: <a href="#OvmOnlyInput">OvmOnlyInput</a>, ) =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="./send#Prepared">Prepared</a>&lt;'ownership'&gt;&gt;</span> | Requests ownership, sent by the future owner (`requestOwnershipHandover`); valid for 48 hours. |
| <code>prepareCancelOwnershipHandover</code> | <span class="sdk-type">( input: <a href="#OvmOnlyInput">OvmOnlyInput</a>, ) =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="./send#Prepared">Prepared</a>&lt;'ownership'&gt;&gt;</span> | Cancels the sender's pending ownership request (`cancelOwnershipHandover`). |
| <code>prepareCompleteOwnershipHandover</code> | <span class="sdk-type">( input: <a href="#CompleteOwnershipHandoverInput">CompleteOwnershipHandoverInput</a>, ) =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="./send#Prepared">Prepared</a>&lt;'ownership'&gt;&gt;</span> | Hands ownership to `pendingOwner` after its request (`completeOwnershipHandover`); owner only. OWNERSHIP_HANDOVER_NOT_PENDING without an unexpired request; roles survive (ROLES_SURVIVE_TRANSFER). |
| <code>prepareTransfer</code> | <span class="sdk-type">(input: <a href="#TransferInput">TransferInput</a>) =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="./send#Prepared">Prepared</a>&lt;'ownership'&gt;&gt;</span> | Sets a new owner and principal recipient in one call (`transfer`); owner only. Roles survive (ROLES_SURVIVE_TRANSFER). |
| <code>prepareSetPrincipalRecipient</code> | <span class="sdk-type">( input: <a href="#SetPrincipalRecipientInput">SetPrincipalRecipientInput</a>, ) =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="./send#Prepared">Prepared</a>&lt;'recipient'&gt;&gt;</span> | Sets the principal recipient (the contract's `setBeneficiary`). |
| <code>prepareSetRewardRecipient</code> | <span class="sdk-type">( input: <a href="#SetRewardRecipientInput">SetRewardRecipientInput</a>, ) =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="./send#Prepared">Prepared</a>&lt;'recipient'&gt;&gt;</span> | Sets the reward recipient (`setRewardRecipient`); owner or SET_REWARD. |
| <code>prepareSetAmountOfPrincipalStake</code> | <span class="sdk-type">( input: <a href="#SetAmountOfPrincipalStakeInput">SetAmountOfPrincipalStakeInput</a>, ) =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="./send#Prepared">Prepared</a>&lt;'principalStake'&gt;&gt;</span> | Sets `amountOfPrincipalStake` (`setAmountOfPrincipalStake`); owner or SET_BENEFICIARY. The preview shows `current`, `next` and `delta`: raising it by 32 ETH pays the reward recipients 32 ETH less at the next distribution. |
| <code>prepareSweep</code> | <span class="sdk-type">(input: <a href="#SweepInput">SweepInput</a>) =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="./send#Prepared">Prepared</a>&lt;'sweep'&gt;&gt;</span> | Sends the principal recipient's pull balance (`sweep`): to the principal recipient by anyone, or to `to` by the owner. `amount` 0 sweeps all. |
| <code>prepareWithdrawPullBalance</code> | <span class="sdk-type">( input: <a href="#WithdrawPullBalanceInput">WithdrawPullBalanceInput</a>, ) =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="./send#Prepared">Prepared</a>&lt;'withdrawPullBalance'&gt;&gt;</span> | Pays out `account`'s pull balance (`withdrawPullBalance`); anyone may send it. NOTHING_TO_DISTRIBUTE when it is 0. |
| <code>prepareRecoverFunds</code> | <span class="sdk-type">( input: <a href="#RecoverFundsInput">RecoverFundsInput</a>, ) =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="./send#Prepared">Prepared</a>&lt;'recoverFunds'&gt;&gt;</span> | Recovers `token` sent to the OVM by mistake to `recipient` (`recoverFunds`); owner or RECOVER_FUNDS. |
